title: Error envelope (ADR 7)
description: The one body every non-2xx JSON answer carries, on /api/v1/ and on the pre-v1 endpoints. request_id equals the X-Request-Id response header.

code.description: invalid_param (400): a parameter is malformed, field names it. not_found (404): no card has the id, or no endpoint has the /api/ path. method_not_allowed (405): the /api/ endpoint exists but not for that method; the Allow header lists the methods it answers. unauthorized (401): an X-Api-Key header names no configured key. es_unavailable (503): Elasticsearch did not answer. overloaded (503): the server already handles as many requests as it admits at once; the Retry-After header says when to try again.

field.description: The parameter at fault; absent when no single parameter is.
